摘要

  • Meet Siri AI. Your AI assistant.More personal. More powerful. Siri AI, powered by Apple Intelligence, comes built into Apple HomeView to help you find what you need and get more done while protecting your privacy.1 Siri AI adapts to each person and surfaces what matters most to them — all they have to do is ask. Available in English to start.Usage limits may apply. Personal Context Relevant to you. Pull up a party invitation from your calendar, find RSVPs buried in your messages, or play the perfect soundtrack to match the vibe. Siri AI works with your paired iPhone or iPad to find relevant content just for you.1 World Knowledge Your little brainiac. Ask about virtually any topic, from quick dinner recipes to DIY home repairs to game-night trivia. Siri AI taps into broad world knowledge to give you highly specific, up-to-date answers. Seamless Experience Carries the conversation. Siri AI lets you ask open-ended questions and go back and forth with natural, rich conversations. And your conversations with Siri on HomeView sync to the Siri app on your other Apple devices so you can pick up where you left off. Heaps of help at home. Apple HomeView does the heavy lifting when you’re busy around the house. Check your calendar, set reminders, and stay on top of your to-do list. Pull up a quick crafting tutorial. Ask Siri AI to recommend a new coffee shop. Start and stop multiple timers for your chores, and keep an eye on them with Live Activities when you’re using other apps. Cooking. When you find a recipe in Safari, just tap the Start Cooking button to view a streamlined format that’s easy to follow. Handoff. Start a song, podcast, call, video, or recipe on iPhone, and continue on HomeView without missing a beat. Apple apps. A selection of Apple apps are available on HomeView. Enjoy Music with lyrics and artwork,7 audio stories on News8 and Audiobooks, and so much more. Additional apps. HomeView supports compatible third-party audio and video apps from your iPhone for a familiar experience across devices.9 Apple apps. A selection of Apple apps are available on HomeView. Enjoy Music with lyrics and artwork,7 audio stories on News8 and Audiobooks, and so much more. Additional apps. HomeView supports compatible third-party audio and video apps from your iPhone for a familiar experience across devices.9 Astounding sound. The mighty yet compact speakers pack a serious punch. Two custom full-range drivers in the display keep everything sounding crisp and clean while delivering room-filling Spatial Audio.4 Computational audio adjusts consistency and balance in real time to deliver incredible sound every time, from anywhere. And a down-firing woofer and two force-cancelling passive radiators are built into the base — for deep, rich bass. Spatial Audio. Fills the room with rich, textured sound for a high-fidelity listening experience.4 Multiroom audio. Use AirPlay to connect with HomePod, Apple TV 4K, and compatible speakers — and just like that, you have a fully connected home sound system.10 Friends and family are just a screen away. Whether you’re calling a friend abroad or calling the kids for dinner, Apple HomeView brings everyone together. Enjoy clear and hands-free FaceTime calls. Use Intercom on HomeView and HomePod speakers to communicate with people throughout the house or on their personal devices like iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch. Send messages and make phone calls using just your voice. And use Find My to help you locate your devices, personal items that have an AirTag, and anybody who chooses to share their location with you. Center Stage keeps everyone in the frame during FaceTime calls, even as they move around or if more people join in. The four-microphone array picks up voices while reducing background noise, for clear calls and Siri requests. Everything connected and under one roof. Apple HomeView is a central hub for your smart home accessories, making it easy to keep things running smoothly. And with the new Apple Home Collection, it’s never been simpler to set up and control a connected home. Integrated with the Home app. Built into HomeView and synced with your other Apple devices, the Home app keeps you on top of your smart home. See who’s at the door, monitor your entryway, access multiple video feeds, adjust the lighting and temperature, and control scenes and automations to fit the routines and rhythms of your household.11 See it all at a glance. The Home Modular face gives you a clear and concise look at your home accessories, while the Home Camera face lets you stream up to nine videos at the same time. And you can manage it all with just your voice or a tap. Enjoy peace of mind. HomeView can detect the sounds of the smoke and carbon monoxide detectors in your home and alert you on your iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch. Stay caught up. The Home app uses Apple Intelligence to group related notifications together, such as when a family member arrives home, unlocks the door, and disables the alarm. And with descriptions of video footage, you can use HomeView to catch up on key activity in and around the house. Multiple users. HomeView can recognize up to six people and seamlessly switch between them. It syncs with each user’s iPhone or iPad and is designed to show their content only when they’re using HomeView.12 Secure Exclaves. The A18 chip inside HomeView contains Secure Exclaves that process the camera and microphone feeds in a secure compartment that cannot be accessed by the operating system or by Apple. This enables HomeView to recognize the face and voice of each user without exposing the audio and visual data used for recognition to the operating system. Personal content. Users can access their personal content on HomeView when their paired iPhone or iPad is connected to the same Wi-Fi network and has been recently unlocked, and HomeView recognizes the person by face. HomeView is deeply integrated within the Apple ecosystem and features a stunning 7-inch Liquid Retina display and Apple‑engineered audio. Because multiple people can use HomeView, it is designed to keep everyone’s personal information separate. Users can access their personal content like Messages and Calendar on HomeView when their paired iPhone or iPad is connected to the same Wi-Fi network and has been recently unlocked, and HomeView recognizes the person by face. The A18 chip inside HomeView contains Secure Exclaves that process the camera and microphone feeds in a secure compartment that cannot be accessed by the operating system or by Apple. This enables HomeView to recognize the face and voice of each user without exposing the audio and visual data to the operating system. HomeView delivers room-filling sound with support for Spatial Audio, making it a great way to enjoy music and podcasts at home. Its custom-engineered acoustic system combines a down-firing woofer and two full-range drivers to produce deep bass and crisp highs. Powered by the A18 chip and built-in sensors, computational audio continuously optimizes the loudness and bass response at any volume. HomeView (Wall Mounted) brings full, balanced sound with two custom drivers and computational audio tuned specifically for on-wall placement, along with support for Spatial Audio. HomeView will be available on apple.com, in the Apple Store app, and from select partners. You can see it in person at all Apple Store locations. You can also book a session to shop with a Specialist in-store or online. Learn more. Subject to availability by partner. HomeView is powered by Apple Intelligence. It features Siri AI — a more personal and powerful AI assistant powered by the A18 chip. With broad world knowledge, anyone in the home can ask Siri about virtually any topic. When paired with an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad, Siri can do even more for each recognized user, like taking action across apps and drawing on personal context to help with everyday tasks. To unlock a full, personalized experience on HomeView, users need an Apple Account, a compatible iPhone or iPad, and to be added as a member of the shared home in the Home app. However, guests and unrecognized users can still easily interact with HomeView to control smart home accessories, check the weather, set timers, and play music — all without accessing anyone’s personal information. Thousands of smart home accessories are compatible with HomeView and Apple Home products. Just look for the Works with Apple Home logo. Lights, locks, cameras, and much more are available. You can also automate many tasks and control all your accessories from the Home app on your Apple devices. Learn more

schmichael 2026/10/13 23:43
The weird thing about this product is that its biggest competitor is "an old ipad." I feel like most of their target customer base already has an old ipad that's better suited for what this does in every way. Old ipads:

1. Have a battery so you're not tied to a cord. Even old poor batteries are better than no battery.

2. Have apps! How does this not support apps?!

3. Have a huge range of 3rd party products and hacks and 3D models to wall mount it or stands for it

4. Are kitchen-safe (splatter proof, far fewer holes than this product, movable out of the way)

5. Also support siri and facetime and everything this device does AFAICT

I'm guessing they realized this and made sure it's priced lower than the cheapest new iPad, but it will be interesting to see if the price difference can compete with the old iPads most of their customers have in drawers or already on walls.

Maybe the purpose-built nature will be a reasonable enough differentiator, but I'm not sure it's focused enough for that. It's both a passive information station and for calls? It's for recipes which implies you put it in the kitchen, but it looks like a nightmare to clean with all those holes? It's also a very small screen when you have to read the recipe from a distance because it has no battery. I can't move my stove to it, and I definitely don't want it too near a stove or sink!

The multiple users feature is a really neat trick, but I would kill to have this for all Apple devices. Let me hand my kid my phone and it automatically switches to kid mode!

Please Apple don't lock multiple users to stationary devices like HomeView!

BurritoAlPastor 2026/10/14 03:42
I can’t believe nobody’s brought this up yet, but the HomeView fundementally exists for one reason: to be a Matter hub for smarthome stuff. No iPad – or any portable Apple device - can be configured as a home hub for managing Matter-protocol devices. There’s no significant advantage to a HomeView over an iPad if you don’t have any Matter devices.

That’s why this device has multi-user support: you’re only supposed to have one of them, which everyone uses. The Apple TV also has good multi-user support, because Apple doesn’t expect you to connect one Apple TV per user to your television.

这就是逻辑的工作原理。如果有人断言“市场是 XYZ”，那么他们必须证明这确实是市场。当人们说“我在 XYZ 并且我绝对不是市场”时，这表明假设是错误的。当别人说“我是 XYZ，我在市场中”时，这是必要条件，但不是充分条件。
That's now how the logic works. If someone asserts "the market is XYZ" then they have to show that actually is the market. When someone else says "I'm XYZ and I'm in the market", that is a necessary but not sufficient condition.
